summary: Parity in pay for BAMS and MBBS doctors; Tikku Committee recommendations; non-discrimination within same cadre; equal pay for equal work; Government Resolution of 01.01.1999 extended benefits to non-MBBS doctors; withdrawal of benefits held impermissible; contempt petitions filed over non-compliance; distinction between legal principle of equal pay and factual determination of equal work; reliance on Dr. Ram Naresh Sharma distinguished due to differing factual and policy context; AYUSH vs. Allopathy not directly analogous for pay parity absent identical duties.
legal_provisions_cited: Dr. Ram Naresh Sharma v. North Delhi Municipal Corporation, 2021 (9) SCALE 47
final_judgment: Appeals allowed in part; impugned judgment set aside; matter remanded to reconsider parity based on factual equivalence of duties and responsibilities.
